pm_exper_user_3671_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: How can I cope when the lead actor I loved most on a long-running show suddenly leaves to work on something else?
pm_exper_user_3671_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) After my favorite Cubs player moved on, I leaned into the excitement of discovering who would step up next — and was surprised by how much I grew to appreciate the new roster. You might try giving the changes in the show a fair shot while holding onto the memories of your favorite actor’s run.
(b) It’s a lot like when your favorite musician leaves a band — it can be a shock, but you can replay their best performances and remember why you connected so deeply. That way you honor what they gave you while being open to what comes next.
(c) When my beloved Cubs shortstop left the team, I started following his new career too — it helped me feel connected without losing my Cubs love. Maybe you could keep tabs on your favorite actor’s new project while still enjoying the show they left behind for what it gave you.
(d) It’s a lot like when my favorite Cubs player got traded — at first it felt like such a gut punch, but I found comfort in rewatching old highlights and celebrating the moments that made me a fan in the first place. You can do the same by revisiting your favorite episodes and remembering why that actor meant so much to you.
